```{r}
library(GENESPACE)
library(here)
```

set wd

```{r}
genomeRepo <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/genomes/"
wd <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/genespace/"
path2mcscanx <- "/Users/yixuanyang/miniforge3/bin/"
```


parse annotation

```{r}
genomes2run <- c("Peronospora_effusa", "Bremia_lactucae", "Phytophthora_sojae")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = genomes2run,
  genomeIDs = genomes2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  genespaceWd = wd)
genomes2run <- c("MSU1", "SC1982", "Phumuli")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = genomes2run,
  genomeIDs = genomes2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd)
```

initialize

```{r}
gpar <- init_genespace(
  wd = wd,
  path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)
```

```{r}
out <- run_genespace(gpar, overwrite = T)
```

```{r}
ripd <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c("MSU1", "Peronospora_effusa", "Bremia_lactucae", "Phytophthora_sojae"),
  pdfFile = here('figures','MSU1.pdf'),
  chrLabFontSize = 2,
  useRegions = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ripd <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c("Phumuli", "Peronospora_effusa", "Bremia_lactucae", "Phytophthora_sojae"),
  pdfFile = here('figures','Phumuli.pdf'),
  chrLabFontSize = 2,
  useRegions = FALSE)
```
